hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: For each member A_i, A_i = O_i[F] where F(z)=f(z). G0002 = F(x), G0003 = F(y), and G0001 = (F(x)-F(y))/(x-y), which is the first-order divided difference of F at nodes x and y.
required_assumptions: x != y for G0001 to be well-defined
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: All three expressions derive from one univariate latent function f: G0002 and G0003 are point evaluations at x and y, and G0001 is the first-order divided difference formed from those evaluations. This explains the observed same-function-family relation among the members using a single latent object and explicit substitution/divided-difference operators.
